mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals an overheating labor market that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months signals an imminent economic downturn that triggers aggressive monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < -0.5% and HOUST MoM growth < -0.5%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.5%), the Federal Reserve maintains high interest rates to combat inflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.0% YoY, it signals an acceleration in price pressures that forces the Federal Reserve to maintain high interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle combined with a strong labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% MoM), the Federal Reserve delays rate cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
